name: Bakunyuu Okami no Yuuwaku ~Kataomoi no Ano Ko e Daitan Kokuhaku! Demo Mucchiri Body no Jukujo ga Ki ni Natte...~
original_name: 爆乳女将の誘惑 ～片想いのあの子へダイタン告白！でもムッチリボディの熟女が気になって…～
source:
Yamaha Shuuyuu wanted to confess his feelings for a girl he had feelings for at a school-sponsored overnight stay event, and to have a relationship between a man and a woman so that he could graduate from being a virgin.

However, things change when he meets the proprietress of the ryokan where he is staying, a beautiful mature woman named Arakawa Sayako. 
Shuuyuu becomes aware of her as a woman for  one reason or another.

He puts aside his one-sided love for the girl he wanted to confess to, and began to seek out Sayako.

"I want the proprietress to take my virginity, if it's with this kind of woman, I'll do what it takes..." 

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_220.html#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
雅马哈修悠想在学校主办的过夜活动中向自己心仪的女孩表白，并建立男女关系，从而让自己从处女身份毕业。

然而，当他遇到了他所住旅馆的老板娘、一位名叫荒川沙耶子的美丽成熟女人时，事情发生了变化。
Shuuyuu出于某种原因意识到她是一名女性。

他放下了对想要告白的女孩的片面爱意，开始寻找沙夜子。

“我要让老板娘夺去我的处女之身，如果是和这种女人，我会不择手段……” 

[来自[url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_220.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
